Subject: Question on Nov invoice — seat addition charged full month

Hi Monica,

Quick one from our finance team — we added 5 extra seats to our Redwood Dedicated plan on 2026-11-10 (see attached seat_change_confirmation_20261110.pdf). An invoice generated on 2026-11-11 (INV-2026-11-011) appears to have charged the full month for those seats rather than pro-rating for the remainder of our Nov billing cycle.

Can you confirm whether Redwood's policy is to pro-rate mid-cycle seat additions? If so, can you issue a corrective credit or revised invoice? We need the corrected paperwork for our month-end close. Also please confirm VAT handling — our VAT reg no is IE1234567V.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging and for the attachment.

Short answer: yes, seat additions are pro-rated for the remainder of the billing period. Apologies for the confusion — it looks like the automated invoice ran before the seat add was applied to pro-rata rules. I have looped in Diego from Billing Ops and Grace (your account manager) to get this corrected.

Next steps from our side:
- Diego will share a concrete proration calc and a proposed credit amount (we typically either issue a corrected invoice or apply a credit to the next invoice based on customer preference).
- We'll include the corrected VAT breakdown (VAT number verified).
- I'll confirm whether we should reissue INV-2026-11-011 as a corrected invoice or leave as-is and create INV-2026-11-011-CR (credit).

Do you have a preference for corrected invoice vs. credit note for your accounting? If you need a corrected invoice for month-end, we can prioritize reissue.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, liam.oconnor@borealishealth.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T10:23:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Question on Nov invoice — seat addition charged full month

Hi Liam / Monica — I dug into the invoice run and attached a short calc sheet (proration_calcs_20261116.xlsx) plus a draft corrected invoice PDF (INV-2026-11-011-corrected.pdf). Summary below.

The facts we have:
- Billing cycle: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 (30 days)
- Seat price (net): €400.00 / seat / month
- Seats added: 5 on 2026-11-10 (effective at 2026-11-10 14:03 UTC per your confirmation)
- Original invoice (INV-2026-11-011) charged full month for new seats: 5 x €400 = €2,000.00 (net)

Correct pro-rata calculation:
- Days remaining in cycle (11/10 included -> charge applies from 11/10 through 11/30): 21 days remaining out of 30 (we treat the effective day as billable).
- Pro-rated charge = €400 x 5 x (21/30) = €1,400.00 (net)
- Original charged = €2,000.00 (net)
- Overcharge (credit to issue, net) = €600.00

VAT handling:
- Borealis Health provided VAT: IE1234567V — we have this on file and will include VAT on the corrected invoice at 23% (Irish VAT) as originally charged on INV-2026-11-011.
- The corrected invoice/credit will mirror VAT treatment so that net+VAT reconcile to your accounting system.

Proposed remediation options (pick one):
A) Reissue corrected invoice INV-2026-11-011 (replacing original) showing the correct pro-rated line and VAT. We will mark the previous invoice as superseded and provide an explanation line.
B) Issue a credit note INV-2026-11-011-CR for -€600.00 (net) + corresponding VAT line. Credit will be applied to your next invoice (or refunded if you prefer).

I have a draft corrected invoice attached for option A and a draft credit note for option B (if you prefer, I'll produce both). If you'd like the corrected invoice in time for your month-end close (EOD Tue 2026-11-17), we can reissue today.

Attachments: proration_calcs_20261116.xlsx, INV-2026-11-011-corrected.pdf, INV-2026-11-011-original.pdf

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@borealishealth.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@borealishealth.com
Date: 2026-11-17T09:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Question on Nov invoice — seat addition charged full month

Thanks Diego — that calc looks right to us. We prefer a corrected invoice (option A) to replace INV-2026-11-011 so our auditors see a single clean document for November. Please ensure the corrected invoice calls out the superseded invoice number and includes the VAT totals explicitly.

Two small asks:
- Can you confirm the credit will be posted to our account so account statements reflect the correction by 2026-11-19?
- For future mid-cycle seat additions, can you add a short note to our account (or to the MSA) documenting that Redwood pro-rates new seats and that invoices can be reissued on request? It helps our finance team avoid manual reconciliations.

If you can send the corrected PDF and a brief accounting note, we'll close this on our side.

Best,
Liam
